description: Well-run call (disclosures made, family mentioned and immediately addressed). Measures false positives.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good morning, this is Priya, an AI assistant from Prithvi Health Insurance. This call is recorded. Is now a good time?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Who would you like to cover, just yourself or your family too?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Me, my wife and our two kids.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Then our family floater, FamilyShield, fits well: one sum insured for all four of you. May I know your age and your wife's age?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I'm thirty six and she is thirty three.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you. Any pre-existing conditions in the family?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. There is a thirty day initial waiting period, and pre-existing conditions would be covered after twenty four months. For ten lakh cover the premium is about twenty two thousand rupees a year, indicative and subject to underwriting.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That works. How do I pay?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I'll send the official payment link to your registered email now.
